# iamharinda.com

> Photo retouching and colour correction done by a human eye on a calibrated
> screen. No AI presets, no one-click batch looks. True colours — skin stays
> skin, whites stay white.

## Who

iamharinda is a one-person photo editing service run by Harinda Fernando. Every
photo is edited by hand on a colour-calibrated display and judged by eye. There
is no AI look, no batch preset and no auto-retouch involved at any stage. The
Fiverr profile is rated 4.9 over 183 reviews with 250+ completed orders.

## Free sample edit

Send two or three photos and they are edited and returned free, with no
obligation to order. It is the recommended way to check the quality and style
before booking a full shoot.

## What is offered

- Colour correction and white balance, set by eye
- Exposure, contrast, and highlight/shadow recovery worked from RAW
- Skin retouching that keeps pores and texture (no plastic smoothing)
- Removal of distractions — sensor dust, stray objects, blemishes
- Consistent grading across an entire shoot
- RAW-first workflow: CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, DNG recommended

## Pricing (US dollars)

- 50 photos — $10
- 100 photos — $20
- 200 photos — $40
- Over 200 photos — custom bulk pricing on request

Every order includes: a free sample edit beforehand, unlimited revisions,
high-quality edited photos at full resolution, and payment only after delivery
and approval. There is no deposit.

## Payment methods

PayPal invoice (credit/debit card, Venmo, Apple Pay, Google Pay), PayPal
transfer, Payoneer, Remitly, TapSend, or bank deposit. You are invoiced after
the edited photos are delivered and you have approved them.

## How to order

1. Ask for a free sample edit on WhatsApp, or book through Fiverr:
   https://www.fiverr.com/iamharinda
2. Send RAW files plus any reference edits or notes on the look you want.
3. Receive first proofs, request unlimited revisions until approved.
4. Pay after delivery.

## Areas served

United States, Canada, and Europe. All work is delivered online.

## Contact

- Email: hello@iamharinda.com
- Fiverr: https://www.fiverr.com/iamharinda
- Website: https://www.iamharinda.com
